messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action so that they walk forward, following the movement shown in the motion reference video. Retain the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use video 0 as the starting point and apply the following edit to it: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action so that they walk forward, as shown in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands with their back to the camera, slowly turning their head and upper body to look out toward the water, then shifts their weight and takes a small step.","camera":"The camera is at a medium distance, framing the person from the thighs up, and remains mostly static with slight handheld movement.","clothing":"The person wears a short, form-fitting dress with a black-and-white houndstooth pattern, featuring a low open back and cold-shoulder cutouts with elbow-length sleeves.","hair_color":"The hair is a vivid, saturated blue.","hairstyle":"The hair is pulled back into a low, rounded updo with two small buns or twists at the nape of the neck.","identity":"A person with a slim build and dark skin is shown from behind, with their face not visible.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor concrete platform or rooftop overlooking a calm, expansive body of water under a clear, pale blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person no longer raises their arms and turns; instead they remain mostly facing away and make small forward/weight-shifting movements with slight head and body turns. The blue hair, houndstooth dress, outdoor waterside scene, and static medium shot are largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to walking forward following the motion reference, while retaining identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression, and leaving scene and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the movement sufficiently follows the reference walking motion.
unexpected_changes: The motion is only a subtle shift/step rather than a clear forward walk matching the reference.
